nodes.label: Planning and Task Breakdown
nodes.rationale: Decompose work into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria. Vertical slicing: build complete feature paths (schema+API+UI) rather than horizontal layers (all DB then all API then all UI).

nodes.label: Vertical Slicing
nodes.rationale: Build one complete feature path at a time instead of all database, then all API, then all UI. Each vertical slice delivers working, testable functionality.

nodes.label: Task Sizing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: XS(1 file)/S(1-2)/M(3-5)/L(5-8)/XL(8+). If L or larger, break down further. Agent performs best on S and M tasks. Checkpoints after every 2-3 tasks.
